a. b.

optimizing technical service units related to complaints of violence against Women;

providing adequate facilities and infrastructure for handling health rehabilitation, social rehabilitation, repatriation, social reintegration, and legal aid; and conducting handling of victims of crime and violence quickly, precisely, and accurately by law enforcement officers.

Article 20

The Women's empowerment system aims to: os -17-

c. provide protection for Women's rights from various forms of violence and other discriminatory treatment.

Article 102

a. appropriate targeting;
b. innovation; and
c. handled professionally, by skilled personnel who have gender sensitivity or gender awareness.

Article 81

a. prevention of violence against Children;

c. strengthening and development of service provider institutions for Children who require special protection.

Article Protection of Women is carried out based on the following principles: respect and appreciation for Human Rights; justice and gender equality; non-discrimination; empowerment; best interests of women; f. guidance and protection; continuity and sustainability; openness; order; legal certainty; and local wisdom. Article Protection of Children is carried out based on the principles of: respect and appreciation for human rights; a. non-discrimination; best interests of the Child; respect for the opinion of the Child; the right to life, grow, and develop of the Child; and local wisdom. f. Article The purpose and objectives of this Regional Regulation are as the basis and guidelines for the Regional Government and stakeholders to: fulfill the rights of Women and Children; a. protect Women and Children maximally, provide a sense of security and peace for Women and Children; prevent the occurrence of violence against Women and Children; empower Women; empower Women victims of violence; f. provide services to Women and Children victims of violence; provide protection to Reporters and Witnesses; maintain the integrity of the household so as to create a harmonious family; encourage the realization of quality families; and
k. increase the participation of non-governmental institutions to support the Region's efforts in providing protection to Women. Article The scope of this Regional Regulation includes: obligations and Responsibilities of the Regional Government; rights of Women and Children; improvement of the quality of life of Women in the Region; protection of Women; family quality; fulfillment of Children's rights; special protection of Children; Gender and Child Data System; i. k. 1. funding; participation of Parents, Family/Relatives and/or Community; monitoring and Evaluation; guidance and Supervision; and
m. prohibitions and sanctions.

Article 89

Social reintegration as referred to in Article 54 letter is carried out in the context of reuniting Women victims of acts of violence with family, substitute family, or community that can provide protection and fulfillment of needs for Women victims of violence.

a. basic wage;

Article The purpose and objectives of this Regional Regulation are as the basis and guidelines for the Regional Government and stakeholders to: fulfill the rights of Women and Children; a. protect Women and Children maximally, provide a sense of security and peace for Women and Children; prevent the occurrence of violence against Women and Children; empower Women; empower Women victims of violence; f. provide services to Women and Children victims of violence; provide protection to Reporters and Witnesses; maintain the integrity of the household so as to create a harmonious family; encourage the realization of quality families; and
k. increase the participation of non-governmental institutions to support the Region's efforts in providing protection to Women. Article The scope of this Regional Regulation includes: obligations and Responsibilities of the Regional Government; rights of Women and Children; improvement of the quality of life of Women in the Region; protection of Women; family quality; fulfillment of Children's rights; special protection of Children; Gender and Child Data System; i. k. 1. funding; participation of Parents, Family/Relatives and/or Community; monitoring and Evaluation; guidance and Supervision; and
m. prohibitions and sanctions.
